annotations.title: JSON to YAML: convert JSON into a readable YAML document

description: Convert a JSON value into a YAML document (block style, no line folding), for config files, Kubernetes manifests, GitHub Actions or docs that humans edit. Up to 100 KB of JSON. Use when a tool or person wants YAML; for the reverse use yaml_to_json. Invalid JSON is a 400, uncharged. Example: json={"name":"agent","ports":[80,443],"enabled":true}. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
